public_rationale: Wikipedia's own moderation record supports a substantial cleanup problem. Hoopla also reports a large screening workload, but its count combines AI-generated and other low-quality titles and concerns material it rejected before delivery. These records support narrower parts of Marcus's statement without settling whether libraries themselves were being inundated.
limitations: Successful screening does not prove that little problematic material reached libraries.
The available evidence is concentrated on English Wikipedia and one library supplier.
